acceptable_paraphrases: A polyhedron made of triangles only
A solid figure with four triangular faces
critical_errors: mistakenly describes a square or rectangular face
refers to any other type of pyramid
misconceptions: Confusing with other pyramids (e.g., square pyramid)
Describing the shape as having a base that is not triangular
Stating it has more or fewer than four faces
grading_notes: Look for clear identification of the tetrahedron and its defining characteristic - four triangular faces. Deduct points for misidentifying other shapes or structures.
